subject: 链路时延注入 - 全链路 timing
description:
每步打 timestamp:
1. 235 /generate 收到 HTTP 请求 → t_request_received
2. 235 TTS 首个 chunk → t_tts_first_chunk
3. 235 TTS 末 chunk → t_tts_last_chunk
4. 235 FlashHead 首个 video frame → t_flashhead_first
5. 235 SDK push 首个 audio + video → t_push_audio_first/video_first
6. 235 generate() 返回 → t_request_returned
7. server.py /carpo-trigger 收到 → t_trigger_received
8. server.py SSH exec 开始 → t_ssh_exec_start
9. server.py SDK pull 首个 audio/video → t_pull_audio_first/video_first
10. server.py Opus/H264 decode 首个 → t_decode_first
11. server.py WebRTC emit 首个 → t_emit_first
12. browser audio.play() / video.play() 首个 → t_play_first
13. browser 计算 end-to-end 显示在屏幕上

每个 timing 推 SSE /events, 浏览器收 + 显示
